note: Incumbent Pete Ricketts (R) seeks a full term. Democratic nominee Cindy Burbank withdrew July 17, 2026; the Nebraska Democratic Party endorsed Osborn. Also on ballot: Chuck Conboy (America First), Mike Marvin (Legal Marijuana Now), Robin Richards (Working People).

cands.name: Pete Ricketts
cands.desc: Senator since 2023 and former two-term governor; runs on tax cuts, border security and spending restraint alongside President Trump.

cands.name: Dan Osborn
cands.desc: Industrial mechanic, former union local president and Navy veteran; nonpartisan candidate who says he would not caucus with either party; endorsed by the Nebraska Democratic Party.

note: Incumbent Jim Pillen (R) seeks a second term. Also on ballot: Brett Lindstrom (America First), Rick Beard (Legal Marijuana Now).

cands.name: Jim Pillen
cands.desc: First-term governor; runs on property tax relief, constitutional carry and border security support.

cands.name: Lynne Walz
cands.desc: Former state senator from Fremont; focuses on the state budget deficit, public schools, jobs and costs; supports implementing voter-approved medical cannabis.
